title: Property graph index design for 2-hop neighbour queries
body:
Our recommender service has to fetch 2-hop neighbours under 50 ms p95.
[Step] Schema
  [Input] users / items / interactions, [Tool] Neo4j 5.20
[Step] Index
  [Parameter] composite index on (user_id, interaction_type), [Output] 2-hop p95 = 32 ms
[Step] Validation
  [Tool] cypher EXPLAIN, [Output] expand-into operator picked up the index
With only a single-property index the planner kept choosing a label scan, which spiked p95 to 180 ms. Composite key was needed for the planner to prefer index seek over scan.
